from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The three adjacent marks on the first row are the source colors.
    sources = [(0, c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0]
    for sr, sc, color in sources:
        targets = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                   if grid[r][c] == color and (r, c) != (sr, sc)]
        if targets:
            tr, tc = targets[0]
            step = 1 if tr >= sr else -1
            for r in range(sr, tr + step, step):
                out[r][sc] = color
            step = 1 if tc >= sc else -1
            for c in range(sc, tc + step, step):
                out[tr][c] = color
        else:
            for r in range(sr, h):
                out[r][sc] = color
    return out
'''
